newsitem.title: GHANA: Gerkens seeks to ship Ghana cocoa in bulk - agents.
newsitem.headline: Gerkens seeks to ship Ghana cocoa in bulk - agents.

text.p: Gerkens Cacao, a Dutch unit of U.S. trader Cargill, wants to ship 25,000 tonnes of unbagged cocoa in December from Ghana's 1996/97 main crop, shipping agents in the Ghanaian port of Tema told Reuters.
It would be the first bulk shipment of Ghanaian cocoa, said one agent.
The Ghana Cocoa Marketing Board (COCOBOD) is said to be hesitant about bulk transport, fearing bean quality could be affected.
Shipping agents said Gerkens staff visited Tema on Thursday to discus the deal and met COCOBOD officials.
Gerkens also chartered 10 vessels from Amsterdam-based Spliethoff to ship 50,000 tonnes of this year's Ivory Coast main crop in bulk, the same sources said.
